# pve-rclone-backup hook

Optional vzdump hook that reports finished archives to the daemon.

The daemon finds finished archives on its own (inotify and periodic scans). The optional vzdump
hook reports them as soon as a backup ends, which helps on network storages written by other nodes.
It is set node-wide in /etc/vzdump.conf; a 'script' set on a backup job overrides it.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`install`](#hook-install) | Set the hook in /etc/vzdump.conf |
| [`status`](#hook-status) | Show whether the hook is installed |
| [`uninstall`](#hook-uninstall) | Remove the hook (restoring a chained one) |

## hook install

Set the hook in /etc/vzdump.conf.

```
pve-rclone-backup hook install [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--chain` | keep an existing hook script and run it after ours |

## hook status

Show whether the hook is installed.

```
pve-rclone-backup hook status
```

## hook uninstall

Remove the hook (restoring a chained one).

```
pve-rclone-backup hook uninstall
```

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
